result: A monograph on non-convex optimization for machine learning: projected gradient descent onto non-convex sets (sparse, low-rank), alternating minimization and EM converge globally when the problem has restricted strong convexity and smoothness, with a chapter on escaping saddle points.
result_plain: Monograph: non-convex PGD, alternating minimization and EM succeed under restricted convexity/smoothness; includes saddle escape.
tabs: Projected GD on a sparse set
